description: This file defines the Android preferences activity for the CubeLiveWallpaper application, specifically providing settings for CubeWallpaper2. It manages preference initialization, lifecycle, and listens for shared preference changes.

classes.name: CubeWallpaper2Settings
classes.description: An Android PreferenceActivity that manages settings for the CubeWallpaper2 live wallpaper, handling preference setup and change lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences from resource and registers preference change listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity resumes; currently just calls superclass.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters preference change listener during activity destruction.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Callback for handling changes to shared preferences; currently empty.
